title: Arrow Operations in Categories of Lattice-valued Relations
summary: Arrow allegories provide a convenient abstract framework to work with lattice-valued relations, or more precisely, relations that use the elements of a given Heyting algebra as truth values. One characteristic of arrow allegories is that all relations of the given arrow allegory use the same Heyting algebra ${\mathcal H}$. In this paper we want to extend this approach to allegories where relations between different objects may use different lattices of truth values and even further to relations that use a different lattice of truth values for every pair in the relation.
